title: Umbra
tagline: Down doubles it. Down might also end it.
description: You carry a lantern down into the dark. Every step down doubles the light you are carrying and raises the chance that the floor gives way and takes all of it. The exact odds are printed on the screen before every step, and they are the odds actually used — nothing is fudged. Bank what you hold at any moment and climb back out, or take one more step. The whole game is that one decision, repeated until you get it wrong.
author: HexCave
controls: Down arrow to descend, space to bank
howToPlay: Two buttons: descend, or bank what you are carrying.
Every step down doubles it and raises the odds it all goes.
The percentage shown is the one actually used.
goal: Bank as much light as you can. Banked light buys permanent lantern upgrades, and the daily descent gives everyone the same sequence of floors.

1.0.0.notes: First release. Curve tuned against twenty thousand simulated descents.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
